Internal helper: jsubset()'s check on a third positional input

Source: R/pipeline-internals.R
dot-jst_extra_conditions_stop.Rd

jsubset(d, Age < 40, Sex == 1) puts its third input in clear.all, where evaluating it gave R's own "object 'Sex' not found". Read from the call as typed, before anything is evaluated, and refused as more than one condition (.jst_one_condition_stop()). The first input is evaluated here only to tell a data frame from a condition, and only on this path, which always stops unless an input is empty. When one of the inputs is off, on or NULL the joined call would be wrong (Age < 40 & on), and .jst_word_with_condition_stop() refuses the mix instead (Session 338; until then those calls were left to fail on R's own "object 'on' not found").

Usage

.jst_extra_conditions_stop(pos, envir)

Arguments

pos

The call's unnamed inputs, unevaluated, three or more.

envir

The caller's environment.

Value

invisible(NULL), or stops.
